summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board decision to sell 36,434,963 common shares (20.7% of total) of affiliate POSCO INTERNATIONAL at KRW 55,400 per share, totaling KRW 2.02 trillion (~$1.5B). The after-hours block trade is scheduled for September 7, 2026, with an OTC fallback if volatile. Post-sale, POSCO retains 87,961,395 shares (50.0%). The stated purpose is reducing the holding company discount and funding strategic investment. A three-year Price Return Swap will hedge price risk between the reference price and disposal value. No put option or advisors named. Watch execution risk of the block trade and any regulatory review.
